scripts.desktop:build: node scripts/desktop-keys.mjs && cross-env STREAMLY_DESKTOP=1 next build && node scripts/desktop-stage.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
